title: Top-degree cohomology of a total tensor of bounded-above free complexes
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring. Let $P^\bullet,Q^\bullet$ be bounded-above cochain complexes of finite free $R$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], with $P^i=0$ for $i>a$ and $Q^j=0$ for $j>b$. Form the direct-sum total tensor complex [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] with differential $d(p\otimes q)=d_Pp\otimes q+(-1)^{\deg p}p\otimes d_Qq$. Then the canonical map $H^a(P^\bullet)\otimes_R H^b(Q^\bullet)\to H^{a+b}(\operatorname{Tot}(P^\bullet\otimes_R Q^\bullet))$ induced by the top-degree tensor representatives is an isomorphism.
